endorsements.quote: Nevertheless, leaderboards should not be the only method for model selection.
Models with broader library support enable smoother training, optimization, distributed computing, and deployment pipelines.

unlisted_practices: Select models that are actively maintained, patched, and updated to ensure a secure and compliant deployment ecosystem.
Move toward private, gated, or dynamic benchmarks with continuously refreshed content to mitigate benchmark contamination.
Involve domain-specific subject matter experts continuously in selecting benchmarks for leaderboards.
Consider community signals such as downloads and likes together with trends and benchmark evaluation metrics before choosing a model.
Prototype shortlisted models early on the intended use case and dataset to evaluate real-world fit.
Use a structured, staged model selection methodology that prioritizes requirements, constraints, and context-specific trade-offs.

screen.reason: The paper is a framework/methodological commentary proposing a Model Selection Methodology (MSM) for navigating LLM leaderboards and benchmarks, using medicine as an illustrative case study.
